description: This Java class `ImmutableJsonPointer` represents an immutable JSON Pointer object, which models a path within a JSON structure using a list of `JsonKey` elements. It provides parsing from string, navigation, extension, and string representation functionalities for JSON pointers, including handling escaped characters and validation. It implements the `JsonPointer` interface.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonPointer
classes.description: An immutable class representing a JSON Pointer as a list of JSON keys, with methods for construction, navigation, and string representation of JSON paths.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of an empty JSON pointer.

methods.name: ofParsed
methods.description: Parses a string representation of a JSON pointer and returns an instance of JsonPointer.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new JSON pointer from a root key and optional sub-level keys.

methods.name: addLeaf
methods.description: Returns a new JSON pointer with an additional key appended at the end.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a sub-pointer to the current JSON pointer, returning a new one.

methods.name: getLevelCount
methods.description: Returns the number of levels (keys) in the JSON pointer.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks whether the JSON pointer has no levels.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the JSON key at a specified level, if exists.

methods.name: getRoot
methods.description: Retrieves the root JSON key, if exists.

methods.name: getLeaf
methods.description: Retrieves the leaf (last) JSON key, if exists.

methods.name: getSubPointer
methods.description: Returns a sub-pointer starting from a specified level.

methods.name: getPrefixPointer
methods.description: Returns a prefix sub-pointer up to a specified level.

methods.name: cutLeaf
methods.description: Returns a new pointer without the last key.

methods.name: nextLevel
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the next level, or itself if not available.

methods.name: toFieldSelector
methods.description: Converts this pointer into a JsonFieldSelector object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of this JSON pointer.
